notes: נָתֹן תִּתֵּן is split under rule 56: *surely* to the infinitive absolute and *thou shalt give* to the finite verb, the ASV having written a separate English word for the emphasis.
אֲחֵי אֲבִיהֶם is recast as the English possessive *their father's brethren*; the determiner stands before the possessor's word and is the suffix's own (rules 18, 29).
הַעֲבַרְתָּ is a light verb plus complement *cause … to pass*, headed on *pass* (rule 44) and discontinuous around the object (rule 25).
